note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their submenus
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, formatting, and view controls)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application status indicators (page number, zoom level, selection info, and mode)
Spreadsheet sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for sheet names (e.g., Sheet1, Sheet2) which are application-generated defaults
